generated_full_moveset.note: Full T3 bank depth merged over curated base; curated moves preserved verbatim. Smallest T3 bank (365 rows, 188 attacks); 79 attack rows have no per-character input in the extracted data (common-bank / reaction rows). Unique playable inputs top out at ~90-97 per fighter.

t7_import_note: Full T7 movelist imported from genuine T7 frame data; existing moves kept verbatim, new moves appended and deduped by input. Heat/rage mechanics unchanged; no T8 data used.

forward_merge.method: semantic union of branch (moveset-cluster-b-t7) and main versions; main keeps contested move keys, branch entries rekeyed <key>_t7 with t7_input recorded; colliding branch specials appended with forward_merge_alt_of
